clauses.text: Each of the following shall constitute an Event of Default: (a) Borrower fails to pay any installment or other amount within ten (10) days after the date due; (b) Borrower fails to perform any other covenant in this Agreement and such failure continues for thirty (30) days after written notice; (c) Borrower becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or becomes the subject of any bankruptcy or insolvency proceeding; or (d) any representation made by Borrower proves to have been false in any material respect when made.
